items.name: MeteredParquetHandler
items.summary: Decorator over an engine-provided `Arc<dyn ParquetHandler>` that emits a `ParquetReadCompleted` span on every `read_parquet_files` call. `read_parquet_footer` and `write_parquet_file` are pass-through and emit nothing.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Wrap `inner`. Debug-asserts that `inner` is not already a [`MeteredParquetHandler`] so spans are emitted exactly once.

methods.name: read_parquet_files
methods.signature: fn read_parquet_files(&self, files: &[FileMeta], physical_schema: SchemaRef, predicate: Option<PredicateRef>) -> DeltaResult<FileDataReadResultIterator>

methods.name: write_parquet_file
methods.signature: fn write_parquet_file(&self, location: url::Url, data: DeltaResultIteratorStatic<Box<dyn EngineData>>) -> DeltaResult<()>
